name: amfx-eurgbp-rate-diff
description: amFX reproduction (12JUN23 p1 top): EURGBP vs Germany/UK 10-year rate differential overlay. Shows FX-rates dislocation and reconvergence after UK CPI release. Rate diff = German 10Y minus UK 10Y. Monthly FRED yields forward-filled to daily. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: EURGBP vs Germany/UK 10-Year Rate Differential
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces top chart from page 1 of amFX 12JUN23 newsletter.
# Dual overlay: EURGBP spot vs (German 10Y - UK 10Y) rate spread.
# The divergence after UK CPI release and subsequent reconvergence
# tells the trade story: higher UK yields attracted capital into GBP.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
eurgbp = src.c

# German 10-year Bund yield (monthly, forward-filled to daily)
de10y_src = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01DEM156N')()
de10y = ffill(de10y_src.result)

# UK 10-year Gilt yield (monthly, forward-filled to daily)
uk10y_src = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01GBM156N')()
uk10y = ffill(uk10y_src.result)

# Rate differential: Germany minus UK (negative = UK yields higher)
rate_diff = de10y - uk10y

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: EURGBP vs Rate Differential Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='EURGBP vs Germany/UK 10Y Rate Differential: Has the Dislocation Closed?',
    category='FX vs Rates',
    y_axis_label='Rate Diff (pp)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DE-UK 10Y Rate Diff', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EURGBP', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero Spread', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, rate_diff, eurgbp)
